recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded source correction in active core source; no additional FHIR-core locations were found that still use the FHIR-50530 obsolete wording.
issue_request: FHIR-50530 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked to clarify RelativeTime by replacing ambiguous 'point in time' wording in the datatype short and long definitions, the offset prose, contextPath wording, and related narrative.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged application commit cc43d09a9f3f9936336550dba0f5c98dec0a60a2 updated source/datatypes.html and source/datatypes/relativetime.xml. Current datatype source already uses the clarified wording, but a later Group update from FHIR-45508 retained the old copied RelativeTime definition sentence in source/group/group-notes.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists group=Group in the active [resources] section, making source/group/group-notes.xml current build input. FHIR-I Madrid minutes for FHIR-50530 explicitly approved wording changes for short/long definitions and other places where 'point in time' was mentioned. Later RelativeTime work such as FHIR-53409 changed EventDefinition support without changing this wording decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/group/group-notes.xml so the Group note now says RelativeTime expresses a time or time period relative to the time of an event, matching the current datatype source and removing the remaining obsolete phrase from source.
source_changes: source/group/group-notes.xml: Replaced the stale copied RelativeTime definition sentence with the clarified current datatype wording.

related_jiras.note: The Group.characteristic.relativeTime notes update retained the obsolete RelativeTime sentence after FHIR-50530 had updated the datatype source; it explains where the remaining source mismatch came from, but this reconciliation only decides FHIR-50530.
Later RelativeTime work added EventDefinition support and confirms continued active editing of the datatype, but it did not supersede or alter the FHIR-50530 wording clarification.
